[{"insert":"1 1/4 Goblet Cyclist Squat Progression

Back to the 1 1/4 goblet cyclist squat with reps dropping to 6 across all working sets. The quarter rep at the bottom continues to double the time under tension in the deepest and most demanding position. With fewer reps, the load goes up. Use your Week 3 working weights as a starting point and increase where you can. The max unbroken drop set at the end finishes the session at Set 1 weight.
"}]
